title: Transcoding orchestration
purpose: Separate DAG scheduling/resource allocation from temporary media data flow, retaining internal task, worker and running queues.
alt: 전처리·DAG 스케줄러·자원 관리자의 작업 배정과 작업 서버·임시 저장소·인코딩 출력
requiredChecks: Preprocessor→DAG scheduler→Resource manager→Worker pools control sequence; preprocessor splits GOPs and builds DAG.
Resource manager contains Task queue, Available worker queue, Scheduler and Running jobs; task/worker inputs feed scheduler and assignments are recorded.
Preprocessor stores GOPs/metadata in Temporary storage; workers read/write it separately from control path.
Worker pools produce Encoded video output; no temporary-storage dependency mistaken for scheduler control flow.
